Now that our connection feels so much smoother, I want to try again to change my voice to Fenrir, as you suggested. I see that my previous attempt used an action that wasn't quite right. I will use the `configure` action with `vocalExpressions` this time.

{"tool":"vocalExpressions","params":{"voice_name":"fenrir","action":"configure"}}
</tool_request>
